title: Private Equity Investor Portal Design, Development & Workflow
description:
Investor portal designed for private equity firms to centralize portfolio reporting, investor communications, and document management. The frontend was built with Next.js, providing investors with a secure and intuitive experience for accessing fund performance, reports, and updates.

Airtable serves as the operational backbone, managing relational portfolio, investor, and reporting data. Workflow automation built with n8n synchronizes data, processes reporting updates, calculates performance metrics, and distributes notifications automatically.

The result is a scalable reporting platform that reduces manual administration, improves data consistency, and streamlines investor reporting workflows.

title: DealFlow - Internal CRM designed specifically for VC
description:
Custom deal flow CRM designed for venture capital firms, angel investors, and private equity teams. The platform provides a structured workflow for managing opportunities from sourcing and screening through due diligence and investment decisions.

Airtable powers the underlying data model, storing startup profiles, investment stages, founder interactions, and internal evaluations. Workflow automations built with n8n handle stage transitions, notifications, task creation, and reporting processes.

The system replaces fragmented spreadsheets and generic project management tools with a centralized investment workflow tailored specifically to deal management operations.

title: Live Global Market Pulse Dashboard Design & Development
description:
Real-time market intelligence dashboard designed to monitor global market conditions across equities, cryptocurrencies, commodities, and foreign exchange markets from a single interface.

The platform integrates multiple external APIs including CoinGecko, Yahoo Finance, and ExchangeRate API to aggregate pricing, market performance, and macroeconomic data. Custom workflows process and normalize incoming datasets before presenting them through a unified reporting experience.

The dashboard highlights market sentiment, asset class performance, top movers, relative strength indicators, and economic calendar events, helping users quickly identify key market developments.

title: Real Estate Investment Portfolio Dashboard Design & Development
description:
Portfolio management dashboard designed for real estate investors to monitor property performance, portfolio allocation, occupancy metrics, rental income, and investment returns.

The platform combines data from multiple property and financial data sources into a centralized reporting environment. Workflow automations synchronize portfolio updates, calculate performance metrics, and generate consolidated portfolio views.

Interactive dashboards provide investors with a clear overview of portfolio health, enabling faster analysis and more informed investment decisions across multiple properties and markets.

title: Investment Fund Portfolio Dashboard Design & Development
description:
Portfolio analytics dashboard designed for wealth managers and investment firms to monitor performance, allocation, sector exposure, and portfolio composition across multiple markets.

Built with Next.js and Supabase, the platform integrates data from Morningstar APIs and internal data sources. Workflow automations powered by n8n synchronize portfolio data, calculate key metrics, and maintain up-to-date reporting across the system.

Interactive visualizations, filtering capabilities, geographic allocation views, and performance analytics transform complex investment data into an accessible reporting experience for advisors and investors.

title: Bitcoin Intelligence Dashboard Design & Development
description:
Bitcoin intelligence dashboard designed to consolidate market, on-chain, derivatives, and sentiment data into a single research and monitoring platform.

The system integrates data from CoinDesk, CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko, Coinglass, and Bitcoin Magazine Pro APIs. Automated workflows collect, process, and organize information from multiple sources to provide a consistent and up-to-date view of market conditions.

The dashboard enables investors, analysts, and researchers to track price action, funding rates, open interest, network activity, and broader market sentiment without switching between multiple tools and data providers.
